snippet.title: Willow Guard Frostreign DLC Announcement Trailer - Coming April 23
snippet.description:
A Lore-Rich Dark Fantasy RPG Set In The Animal Kingdom, now with a Companion! ⚔

The tale of our brave badger continues as the party sets out for Regnum Polis, racing to prevent another monstrous breakthrough before the next Solstice. The journey from Woikos leads through the frozen Atalaka Mountains, now rendered impassable by an unnatural winter brought on by Louksna. The only safe passage lies in the use of ancient portals.

Soon, it becomes clear that some of these portals are being disrupted by an unknown entity from Alteros—the realm of monsters. On the far side of one such portal, Ghweros glimpses a small, hooded figure deftly fighting and evading the creatures of Alteros before vanishing from sight. The figure turns out to be Súri, a young wolverine orphan who soon becomes your apprentice.

🔥 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4413850/Willow_Guard__Frostreign/
🔥 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/EpW69MP
🔥 Official pages: https://www.willowguard.games/
